templates.title: Label templates
templates.intro: Design the labels you stick on card holders: pick the sheet, set its margins, grid and spacing, then lay out a label with card fields, QR codes and barcodes. Print them from a card selection or a location.
templates.noPermission: You can print labels, but only users who manage label templates can change them.

designer.name: Template name
designer.noRoom: The margins and spacing leave no room for the labels.
designer.fieldsHelp: An element is filled from the card when its Name is a field's name (shown in grey). To put several fields in one line, add a Text with fields element and type them in braces, e.g. {setCode} #{collectorNumber}.
designer.testPrintHint: Fills a sheet with a sample card and outlines every label — print it on plain paper and hold it against your label sheet.
